gate_changes_reviewed.change: Cross-sample Utility audit confirmed artifact-to-handoff semantic fidelity defects in two independent completed Architecture chains
Temporal mismatch remained decision-neutral after exact artifact reconciliation; no historical artifact or classification was rewritten
Top-k cycle 1 handoffs propagated an incorrect claim that magnitude 0.01 cleared all fixed signal requirements despite turnover support 1 < minimum 20
Fresh v0.5 config Architecture contract prospectively binds artifact fidelity fields and preserved fixed science through a pre-diagnostic lint repair

false_positive_risks: Manual semantic transcription can overstate support breadth or criterion satisfaction even when artifact identity and top-level classification are preserved
Incorrect lower-level summaries can propagate one or more control-plane hops and influence successor design before being noticed
Local Architecture cutoffs could be laundered into novelty or FORMAL admission rules if claim-type boundaries are ignored
Stronger-privilege ceilings could be mistaken for equal-resource mechanistic comparators
false_negative_risks: A machine-fidelity fix could become overconservative if any prose mismatch automatically rejects the scientific object instead of blocking only interpretation-dependent continuation
Reacting to transcription defects with universal replication or stronger support requirements would suppress modest but useful Architecture/API questions
Using new-principle novelty as the threshold for engineering, reproducibility, API, or testbed value would recreate programme-wide overconservatism
Fitting a new universal support threshold to completed Top-k outcomes would create post-outcome goalpost movement

notes: workflow/head/artifact digests validate provenance while semantic-summary validation checks interpreted machine content; these are complementary
one-way execution integrity does not guarantee correct handoff transcription
fresh Analyst review and machine-checkable handoff binding protect different failure stages

moving_goalpost_assessment.basis: The completed Utility audit rewrote no historical artifact, label, threshold, allocation, or identity. Its recommendation is prospective. The v0.5 lint repair preceded any outcome-bearing diagnostic and kept the scientific contract unchanged.

required_path: support or uncertainty adequate to the local question
matched equal-privilege comparators for mechanistic claims
survive ordinary implementation and dynamical reductions
faithful machine-bound artifact ingestion and interpretation
pass_reachability_assessment.current_limit: No active PRE_FORMAL or FORMAL object; adding fidelity validation is procedural integrity rather than a substantive novelty hurdle.

external_calibration.use_rule: External literature and audits calibrate prospective reductions and claim boundaries only; they do not override machine artifacts or rewrite consumed evidence.

opportunity_cost_assessment: A structured fail-closed machine handoff checker has high integrity information gain with low scientific opportunity cost when limited to decision-relevant machine-bound fields. Additional substantive scientific strictness would cost more research opportunity for less calibration benefit.
prospective_recommendations: Keep the four-layer funnel, strict FORMAL novelty bar, comparator discipline, ordinary-reduction-first interpretation, and hard integrity floor unchanged.
Adopt a structured machine-checkable handoff binding for future outcome-bearing lower-funnel artifacts before interpretation-dependent successor allocation.

Bind workflow/head, artifact identity/digest, candidate/contract identity, raw digest/cardinality where present, mapped outcome, canonical machine-summary digest, and narrated decision-relevant machine fields.
On mismatch, preserve the artifact as authority and block only successor allocation that depends on disputed fields until reconciliation; do not automatically reject the candidate.
Do not retroactively rescore, relabel, rerun, invalidate, or upgrade Temporal or Top-k because of the new methodology recommendation.
Do not increase universal scientific support/replication thresholds to solve a control-plane transcription problem.
Use the fresh v0.5 Architecture handoff as a natural prospective end-to-end validation target if Control/Evidence Analyst implement the generic guard.
questions_for_control_brain: Will the completed repeated-fidelity finding be converted into a generic fail-closed machine-checkable handoff prerequisite for interpretation-dependent successor allocation?

Will historical handoffs remain immutable, with any reconciliation recorded append-only rather than rewritten?
questions_for_evidence_analyst: Will future Architecture closure handoffs consume a structured machine summary or binding object rather than manually restating decision-relevant counts and threshold applications?
Will a mismatch produce HOLD/reconciliation rather than scientific rejection or post-outcome repair?
Can the fresh v0.5 config Architecture object serve as the first prospective end-to-end test of the generic fidelity guard without changing its scientific contract?
